name: turtel-14b-grpo

image_note: ships vllm 0.28.0 + its pinned torch 2.13.0; bootstrap.sh adds trl/peft/accelerate/datasets pins and falls back to pip-installing vllm==0.28.0 if the image is different. Unverified until the first rental.

gpu_split: vLLM rollout server on GPU 3 (TRL server mode, NCCL weight transfer); trainer DDP on GPUs 0-2 via accelerate --num_processes 3

expected.cost_estimate_usd: 135-275 at the 20 Sep quote of $8.86/h for 4xH100 SXM
